---
title: "processed_data"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

alaska <- read.csv("../raw/_alaska-attributes.csv")
arc_canN <- read.csv("../raw/_arctic_canada_north-attributes.csv")
arc_canS <- read.csv("../raw/_arctic_canada_south-attributes.csv")
gln_per <- read.csv("../raw/_greenland_periphery-attributes.csv")
wCanUS <- read.csv("../raw/_western_canada_usa-attributes.csv")
```

```{r}
alaska |> 
  full_join(arc_canN) |> 
  full_join(arc_canS) |> 
  full_join(gln_per) |> 
  full_join(wCanUS) |> 
  select(-glims_id, -o1region, -o2region, -rgi_id, -anlys_id, -subm_id, -surge_type, -term_type, -conn_lvl, -primeclass, -glac_name, -src_date)
```
